info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking It Management Systems Operation By Systems Operation Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking IT Management Systems Operation Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about specific banking IT management system operations using their unique operation IDs. This endpoint is essential for developers and IT professionals who need to monitor, troubleshoot, or report on operations within banking systems. Typical use cases include retrieving operational metrics, gaining insights into system performance, and auditing actions taken on the systems. By providing immediate access to operational data, this API supports efficient management of banking IT resources.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific system operation.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific system operation identified by its unique resource ID. It provides insights into the operational state and relevant metrics, facilitating better management and oversight of IT systems.
